recommended_project_title: MineShark-Tor: Early-Stage and Lightweight Tor Encrypted Traffic Behavior Recognition
selection_rule: Do not choose the paper dataset merely because it is already local. Prefer public Tor website-fingerprinting datasets released by, constructed by, or repeatedly reused in recent top security/networking venues such as USENIX Security, IEEE S&P, ACM CCS, NDSS, and PAM. The first paper dataset must support closed-world evaluation and should support at least one realistic extension: open-world, multi-tab, drift/cross-environment, defense robustness, or subpage/generalization.

datasets.paper_or_artifact: Realistic Website Fingerprinting by Augmenting Network Traces / NetCLR and NCDrift traces
datasets.notes: Strong P0 candidate because it is recent, top-venue related, locally available, and aligned with realistic WF, drift, and cross-condition evaluation. It should be evaluated as website-class data, not only as the old condition-pair binary risk baseline.

datasets.paper_or_artifact: Dataset for Website Fingerprinting Attack Evaluation / Website Fingerprinting Library
datasets.notes: Strong reproducibility candidate. Local CW conversion already has 105730 samples and 95 classes. Use as a standardized closed-world reproduction or fallback if NetCLR multiclass interpretation becomes too awkward.

datasets.venue: IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy 2023
datasets.paper_or_artifact: Robust Multi-tab Website Fingerprinting Attacks in the Wild / Multitab-WF-Datasets
datasets.notes: Authoritative multi-tab candidate. It is attractive for realism but should be a second-stage dataset because multi-label training and metrics are more complex than the first C-paper closed-world pipeline.

datasets.paper_or_artifact: Stop, Don't Click Here Anymore: Boosting Website Fingerprinting by Considering Sets of Subpages
datasets.notes: Important methodology reference for data diversity, subpages, and realistic user navigation. Use as a survey-backed motivation even if the artifact is not used in the first experiment.
Use as a living index to avoid choosing outdated or obscure data. It is not itself the first training dataset.

datasets.paper_or_artifact: Automated Website Fingerprinting / Rimmer-style AWF traces
datasets.notes: Classic baseline only. The local directory exists but currently has no files, so it must not be treated as ready.
Classic strong baseline and frequently reused, but not new enough to be the authority anchor for this paper.
Useful for related work and baseline discussion, but not a latest authoritative main dataset.
